solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: A drug dealer's yacht, and a rope thrown out

indicators.note: something thrown out is knocked out of shape, so these letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A narcotics trafficker owns a boat, and some rope has been tossed overboard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thrown out' rearranges YACHT and A ROPE together; 'and' only joins the two parts of the fodder, and the 's stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: An apothecary was the old name for a chemist who prepared and sold medicines, literally a seller of drugs.

clue.text: Ship making a right turn

parts.note: taken as written
a go is a turn in a game

explanation.surface: A vessel swings to starboard.
explanation.walkthrough: Argo was the ship of Jason and the Argonauts in Greek myth.
explanation.definitionFit: The Argo is the ship in which Jason sailed to fetch the Golden Fleece.

clue.text: Go too far regarding fire

parts.note: over can mean about or concerning, as in a row over money
to shoot is to fire a gun

explanation.surface: Overreach on the subject of opening fire.
explanation.definitionFit: To overshoot is to go past an intended mark or target, going too far.

clue.text: Hospital put girl up for shock treatment

parts.note: H is the standard abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the name is written bottom to top, so reversed

parts.note: Anne is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A hospital sent a young woman off for electroconvulsive therapy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses ANNE to ENNA. A shock is a mass of hair, so the treatment is a dye, not electricity.
explanation.definitionFit: Henna is a reddish dye used to colour hair, a treatment for a shock of hair.

clue.text: Short article on popular call at the theatre

parts.note: curt means short or abrupt
a is the indefinite article
in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: A brief newspaper piece on a fashionable summons in a playhouse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is just a link joining the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A curtain call is when actors return to take a bow, so the word fits a call at the theatre.

clue.text: Weapons charges must include one disheartened ecowarrior

indicators.note: must include means the word for charges holds the other pieces inside it

parts.note: raps are criminal charges, as in taking the rap
one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: disheartened means the word ecowarrior loses all its middle, keeping only its outer letters

explanation.surface: Accusations relating to arms have to involve a demoralised environmental activist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disheartened' strips out the whole middle of the activist word, leaving only its first and last letters; 'must include' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapiers are slender thrusting swords, a kind of weapon.

clue.text: A nuisance is unfinished mirrors

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: unfinished means the word loses its final letter, cutting it short

parts.note: a pest is an annoying person or thing, a nuisance

explanation.surface: Someone complains that looking-glasses are an incomplete annoyance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfinished' cuts the last letter from PEST to leave PES. 'mirrors' is a verb here, not the noun the surface suggests.
explanation.definitionFit: To ape someone is to copy or imitate them, just as a reflection mirrors its subject.

clue.text: Bit of a hand to cover second song

indicators.note: to cover means the word for part of a hand goes round the other letter

parts.note: the palm is part of the hand

explanation.surface: Use part of your hand to shield a moment of music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to cover' wraps PALM round S, after its P.
explanation.definitionFit: A psalm is a sacred song or hymn, especially one from the Book of Psalms.

clue.text: Leads attack as hare sped off

indicators.note: off suggests the letters of as hare sped have gone wrong and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone heads the charge while a rabbit-like animal races away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' rearranges AS HARE SPED.
explanation.definitionFit: To spearhead something is to lead it at the front, as of an attack.

clue.text: Low spirits? Start drinking ancient spirits

indicators.note: start means only the first letter of the word drinking is taken

parts.note: old means ancient
rums are alcoholic spirits

explanation.surface: Feeling down? Begin drinking vintage liquor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Start' takes D from DRINKING. The two senses of 'spirits', mood and alcohol, play off each other.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in the doldrums means being in a state of gloom or depression.

clue.text: Gather there's action starting in valley

indicators.note: in places the first letter inside the word for valley

parts.note: a glen is a narrow valley, especially in Scotland

indicators.note: starting means only the opening letter of the word action is used

explanation.surface: Collect the idea that something is beginning to happen down in the dale.
explanation.definitionFit: To glean is to gather bit by bit, originally collecting leftover grain after a harvest.

clue.text: Rogue makes refund including half of profit

indicators.note: including means the word for refund holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: a rebate is a partial refund of money paid

indicators.note: half of means the first three of the six letters of profit are used

explanation.surface: A scoundrel arranges a repayment that keeps back part of the gain for himself.
explanation.definitionFit: A reprobate is an unprincipled scoundrel, a synonym for a rogue.

clue.text: A daughter boarding flight for a prank

indicators.note: boarding means getting on to, so the two letters go inside the word for flight

parts.note: flight in the sense of fleeing is an escape
taken as written
D is the standard abbreviation for daughter in family trees

explanation.surface: A young woman gets on an aeroplane just for a lark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flight' looks like an aeroplane journey but means running away; 'boarding' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An escapade is a reckless or mischievous adventure, a kind of prank.

clue.text: Take exception, being almost sober

indicators.note: almost means the word loses its last letter, falling just short

parts.note: demure means modest, reserved and sober in manner

explanation.surface: Someone objects to being described as nearly teetotal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' drops the final E from DEMURE.
explanation.definitionFit: To demur is to raise an objection, which is to take exception to something.

clue.text: Remove all traces of oil with a better process

indicators.note: to process something is to work it over, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Clean away every bit of grease using an improved treatment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'process' rearranges OIL and A BETTER; 'with' just joins them.
explanation.definitionFit: To obliterate is to wipe out entirely, leaving no trace behind.

clue.text: Extend thoroughfare through mountain

indicators.note: through means the road runs inside the mountain word, like a tunnel

parts.note: ben is a Scottish word for a mountain, as in Ben Nevis
a road is a public thoroughfare

explanation.surface: Lengthen the highway by tunnelling it under a peak.
explanation.walkthrough: Ben Nevis is Scotland's highest peak, which is why the Scots word works for 'mountain'; 'through' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To broaden something is to widen or extend its scope.

clue.text: Rock singer's first suit

parts.note: rock is slang for a diamond

indicators.note: first means only the opening letter of the word singer is taken

explanation.surface: A rock vocalist's debut outfit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rock' looks like a music genre but is slang for a gem; 'suit' means a suit of cards, not clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Diamonds is one of the four suits in a pack of playing cards.

clue.text: Complacent, starts to get lost and ends run

parts.note: smug means complacently self-satisfied

indicators.note: starts to means the opening letter of each of the following words is taken

explanation.surface: A self-satisfied person begins to wander off and finishes a jog.
explanation.walkthrough: 'starts to' takes the first letters of GET, LOST and ENDS to make GLE; 'and' is only a link. 'run' is the definition, as in running contraband.
explanation.definitionFit: To run goods is to carry them illegally across a border, which is to smuggle them.

clue.text: Where there's talk on the origin of wine?

definitions.meaning: an informal route by which rumour and gossip pass from person to person
the climbing plant on which the fruit used to make wine grows

explanation.definitionFit: Hearing something on the grapevine means through gossip, and the grapevine is literally the plant that yields wine grapes.

clue.text: One initially tense during approaches is visibly upset

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: during means the letter sits within the word for approaches

parts.note: nears means comes closer to, approaches

indicators.note: initially means only the first letter of the word tense is used

explanation.surface: A nervous person becomes noticeably distressed while getting nearer.
explanation.walkthrough: I comes first, then 'during' puts T inside NEARS to give NTEARS.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone in tears is crying, which is a plainly visible sign of being upset.

clue.text: Seamstresses boxing 1000 pins

indicators.note: boxing means enclosing, so the word for seamstresses goes round the letter

parts.note: sewers are people who sew, such as seamstresses
K stands for a thousand, from kilo

explanation.surface: Dressmakers fight over a thousand pins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boxing' puts K inside SEWERS after its S. 'Seamstresses' gives SEWERS, people who sew, not drains.
explanation.definitionFit: Skewers are long pins used to hold meat together, so the words are synonyms.

clue.text: Worker catches bus in order to save

indicators.note: catches means the word for worker holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: a hand is a manual worker, as in farmhand

indicators.note: in order suggests the letters of bus are put into a different arrangement

explanation.surface: An employee makes sure to catch the bus to cut costs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in order' sounds like 'so as to' but is the anagram signal; 'catches' is the container signal, and 'save' is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To husband resources is to manage them thriftily, to save or conserve them.

clue.text: Expensive hot drink and meal

parts.note: high prices are expensive ones
tea is a hot drink

explanation.surface: A costly cup of something hot, plus food.
explanation.walkthrough: High tea is a British early-evening meal, usually a cooked dish with bread and tea.
explanation.definitionFit: High tea is an early evening meal in Britain, often including cooked food served with tea.

clue.text: Muse a long time — and return books

parts.note: an era is a long period of time

indicators.note: return means the letters for books are turned to read backwards

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament, the first books of the Bible

explanation.surface: Someone thinks for ages before taking library books back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Muse' looks like a verb meaning ponder but is a proper noun; 'return' reverses the books.
explanation.definitionFit: Erato is one of the nine Muses of Greek myth, presiding over lyric and love poetry.

clue.text: Lively beer — right temperature

parts.note: ale is a kind of beer

explanation.surface: A sparkling ale served at just the right temperature.
explanation.definitionFit: Being alert means being quick, wide awake and lively.

clue.text: Scratched, but serious in intent

indicators.note: in places the word for serious inside the word for intent

parts.note: an end is an aim or purpose, an intent
grave means serious

explanation.surface: Something was scraped, yet the purpose behind it was earnest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'intent' is a noun meaning aim or purpose here, not the adjective meaning eager; 'in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To engrave is to cut a design into a surface, so engraved writing has been scratched in.

clue.text: A model looking back for guy who spun stories

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: looking back means the word for model is read in reverse

parts.note: to pose is to model for an artist

explanation.surface: A fashion model reflects on a fellow who told tall tales.
explanation.walkthrough: Aesop was the ancient Greek teller of fables such as The Tortoise and the Hare; 'looking back' reverses only the model.
explanation.definitionFit: Aesop was the ancient Greek storyteller famous for his fables.

clue.text: Experienced in soft fabric

definitions.meaning: underwent or sensed, past tense of the verb meaning to sense
a cloth made of matted, pressed wool fibres

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the past tense of sensing something and a soft cloth made from compressed wool.

clue.text: Soldiers on a date, soldiers with time for change

indicators.note: on means the word for soldiers is placed after the letter before it

parts.note: taken as written
men are ordinary soldiers, as opposed to officers
men again means soldiers

explanation.surface: Troops on a romantic outing, joined by more troops, must allow time to alter plans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' sets MEN after A; then D, MEN again and T follow in order.
explanation.definitionFit: An amendment is an alteration made to a text or law, a change.

clue.text: Bird shot

definitions.meaning: a long-billed wading bird of marshland
a shot fired from a hidden position, or a sharp verbal attack

explanation.definitionFit: The name of a wading bird also means a shot from cover, as in a sniper's shot or a sniping remark.

clue.text: Raises the temperature in London and breaks fast

indicators.note: in London points to the Cockney habit of dropping the initial h from a word

parts.note: heats means warms up, raises the temperature

explanation.surface: London warms up and ends its fasting.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockney speech, the traditional accent of London's East End, drops an initial H, so HEATS becomes 'EATS.
explanation.definitionFit: To eat is to end a fast, which is exactly what breaking fast means.

clue.text: Geographical feature shown in recent maps after review

indicators.note: after review the letters of recent maps are reconsidered and set out again in a new order

explanation.surface: A landform appears on newly checked charts.
explanation.definitionFit: An escarpment is a long steep slope or cliff, a type of landform.
